\textit{Notes.} Coefficients on the log-odds scale; standard errors in parentheses. $^{*}$p$<$0.1; $^{**}$p$<$0.05; $^{***}$p$<$0.01. Firth columns: penalised-likelihood logit (rare events), $p$-values from the penalised likelihood-ratio test. Universe: the place universe of Table~\ref{tab:descriptives}, less places without 2020 vote data (Alaska, Hawaii, and places with no reallocated returns). Camera exposure enters as both margins of the hurdle: whether the place has any mapped camera, and how many. Descriptive associations, not causal effects. \textit{Any restriction} = any confirmed pause, ban, or rejection through September 30, 2026; \textit{Ban} = cancelled, not renewed, banned by ordinance, or cancelled to switch vendor; \textit{Pause} = suspended pending review. Column 4: ordinary logit with state fixed effects and state-clustered standard errors; states with no restricting place drop out. Robustness checks in Table~\ref{tab:ban-models-robust}.
